name: nextjs
serverRuntimeNote: Next.js has a server runtime built in. Even when the backend axis is a BaaS, server code lives in Route Handlers·Server Actions — this is a value that must be passed to the backend side when a seam is created, because where the handlers live is the premise of the entire backend guide.
fixesVariantsNote: Next.js decides fetching·routing·the server runtime on its own, so the only things this axis pins down separately are client state and forms. For a project that has settled on Redux·Jotai, this pack's state-management section becomes wrong guidance
